I16c2c45b8b15f0e6b3cf5bd3208fcb19514f5b1.subject: [HP2236BVA-34][TR069] Fix Issue that Sub router included in the Host list

commit bc10b1ff91f31ff645bd25a8b6231c44b50be13a
Author: DEOKWONKANG <dwkang@humax-networks.com>
Date:   Thu Mar 5 00:52:15 2026 +0000

    [HP2236BVA-34][TR069] Fix Issue that Sub router included in the Host list
    
     - InternetGatewayDevice.LANDevice.1.Hosts
    
    Change-Id: I16c2c45b8b15f0e6b3cf5bd3208fcb19514f5b12

diff --git a/tclinux_phoenix/apps/hni/cwmpclient/ext/openwrt/scripts/functions/tr098/lan_device b/tclinux_phoenix/apps/hni/cwmpclient/ext/openwrt/scripts/functions/tr098/lan_device
index 232b606233b..215f9761ecf 100644
--- a/tclinux_phoenix/apps/hni/cwmpclient/ext/openwrt/scripts/functions/tr098/lan_device
+++ b/tclinux_phoenix/apps/hni/cwmpclient/ext/openwrt/scripts/functions/tr098/lan_device
@@ -2362,9 +2362,16 @@ hosts_browse_instances() {
 	local client_count
 	client_count=$(echo "$result" | jsonfilter -e '@.number_client')
 	local index_device=$(echo "$parameter" | sed -n 's/.*Hosts\.Host\.\([0-9]\+\).*/\1/p')
+	local host_idx=0
 
 	for i in $(seq 0 $((client_count - 1))); do
-		offset=$((i + 1))
+		local netType
+		netType=$(echo "$result" | jsonfilter -e "@.infor[$i].networkType")
+		[ "$netType" = "backhaul" ] && continue
+
+		host_idx=$((host_idx + 1))
+		offset="$host_idx"
+
 		if [ -n "$index_device" ] && [ "$index_device" -ne "$offset" ]; then
 			continue
 		fi
@@ -2420,14 +2427,23 @@ hosts_browse_instances() {
 
 get_HostNumberOfEntries() {
 	local result
-		result=$(ubus call hni getLanDeviceList "{}" 2>/dev/null)
-		if [ -z "$result" ]; then
-				return 0
-		fi
+	result=$(ubus call hni getLanDeviceList "{}" 2>/dev/null)
+	if [ -z "$result" ]; then
+		return 0
+	fi
+
+	local client_count
+	client_count=$(echo "$result" | jsonfilter -e '@.number_client')
+
+	local cnt=0
+	local i netType
+	for i in $(seq 0 $((client_count - 1))); do
+		netType=$(echo "$result" | jsonfilter -e "@.infor[$i].networkType")
+		[ "$netType" = "backhaul" ] && continue
+		cnt=$((cnt + 1))
+	done
 
-		local client_count
-		client_count=$(echo "$result" | jsonfilter -e '@.number_client')
-		echo $client_count
+	echo "$cnt"
 }
